notes:
Account background: ProductiveAI builds a B2B helpdesk + agent orchestration layer. Mid-market scale (200-600 employees). CTO (Maya Singh) pushed to migrate off incumbent LLM API after repeated latency regressions in their chat flows. Interested in Redwood for streaming + tool-calling reliability and predictable unit economics.

Summary of conversations: 
- 2026-02-10 discovery call (Avery, Sam) - high-level product fit: chat-first product, tool calling to calendar/CRM, latency SLOs 150-250ms p50 for streaming chunks, p99 < 900ms end-to-end for agent responses. Cost sensitive but will pay premium for consistent latency.
- "We saw p99 spike to 3-4s during peak; customers notice and abandon flows" - quote from Maya (CTO).
- 2026-02-18 demo (Sam) - showed Redwood Hosted streaming and function/tool call wiring. Product team liked continuous streaming and partial output tokens.
- POC initiated 2026-02-20: 2-week benchmarking comparing Redwood hosted streaming vs incumbent (OpenAI) on production-like traffic. Focus: streaming token latency, tool call handshake time, stability under burst.
- POC results 2026-02-28 (summary): Redwood streaming p50 token latency 120-180ms, p95 ~420ms; incumbent p50 210-320ms, p95 800-1.2s with intermittent spikes to 2-3s. Tool-call roundtrip (invoke->tool->response) avg Redwood 350ms vs incumbent 700ms. SE notes: stable KV-cache behavior improved response times for repeated prompts.
- Security review requested 2026-02-25: SOC2 report + SSO/SAML flow sample + KMS integration guidance. Sent security FAQ (drive link above).
- Pricing discussion 2026-03-01: asked for dedicated reserved capacity pricing (monthly commit) and committed p99 latency SLA language. They want runbooks for fallback to hosted variants.

Notes/obs: shorthand and todo's sprinkled in CRM thread. Team really cares about streaming smoothness (partial tokens) and function-calling reliability. They asked about headroom for burst + autoscaling for Dedicated.

POC artifacts: drive:/ProductiveAI/POC/streaming-benchmarks.xlsx (raw numbers), ff_10012_poc-review-2026-02-28 (call recording).

Next steps: get Dedicated pricing + draft SLA, legal review on data residency, schedule canary POC in prod sandbox, SE to validate tokenization differences on their top-20 prompts.
